faq_heading: Questions B2B teams ask about LinkedIn AI lead generation

faqs.q: What is LinkedIn AI lead generation?
faqs.a: It is using AI to do the repeat work of LinkedIn prospecting: finding people who match your buyer profile, sending short personal messages, following up and sorting replies. A person on your side takes the sales calls.

faqs.q: Is an AI agent the same as a LinkedIn automation tool?
faqs.a: No. A tool runs the sequence you set up and leaves you to build the list, write the copy and read the replies. An agent does the daily work for you and reports back, so your time goes to the calls.

faqs.q: Is LinkedIn AI lead generation safe for my account?
faqs.a: Any automation carries some risk, because LinkedIn restricts activity that breaks its rules. Keeping volume modest, messages personal and a person checking the work lowers it. High-volume blasting is the real danger.
Replies are sorted into interested, not now and not a fit. Warm ones reach you on WhatsApp with the conversation, so you or your sales head can take the call.

faqs.q: How long before I know if it works?
faqs.a: We aim to show you a first demo within 7 days. After going live, judge it over a full month on four numbers: people reached, acceptances, real replies and booked calls.
